global_rules.aesthetic: Modern 2026 SaaS style, Stripe simplicity, Linear minimalism, Vercel aesthetic
global_rules.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8, p-12 for internal card padding to create an airy feel.
global_rules.alignment: Max-width 720px centered container for the entire app. No sidebars, no dashboard clutter. The app operates inside a focused 'Command Center' card.
global_rules.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows for the main card (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(79,70,229,0.08)]) to lift it off the #F9FAFB background.

hierarchy.pin_display: text-6xl sm:text-7xl font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-indigo-600 text-center select-all

main_container.classes: max-w-[720px] mx-auto w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(79,70,229,0.08)] border border-gray-100 p-8 sm:p-12 relative overflow-hidden
main_container.notes: Ensure vertical centering on the viewport if content is short.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-gray-100 transition-all duration-200 border border-gray-200
buttons.toggle_group: flex bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-xl w-full max-w-[240px] mx-auto mb-10
buttons.toggle_active: bg-white text-gray-900 shadow-sm rounded-lg py-2 px-4 w-1/2 text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-200 text-center cursor-pointer
buttons.toggle_inactive: text-gray-500 py-2 px-4 w-1/2 text-sm font-medium hover:text-gray-700 transition-all duration-200 text-center cursor-pointer

upload_zone.classes: border-2 border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50/50 hover:bg-indigo-50/50 hover:border-indigo-400 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer group min-h-[240px]
upload_zone.icon_classes: w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 group-hover:text-indigo-500 transition-colors duration-200 mb-4

inputs.pin_input_cell: w-14 h-16 sm:w-16 sm:h-20 text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-center font-mono font-bold bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:border-indigo-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-600/20 focus:bg-white transition-all duration-200 outline-none
inputs.select: w-full bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-gray-900 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-600/20 outline-none transition-all duration-200

progress_bar.fill: h-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300 ease-out rounded-full

background_texture.description: Abstract minimalist background, soft light gray and white with a subtle, glowing electric blue geometric glass sphere floating.
background_texture.usage: Optional: Use as a fixed background image for the body with opacity-30 and mix-blend-multiply to add subtle texture behind the 720px app container.

file_icon_3d.description: Minimalist 3D icon of a folded paper plane or file, frosted glass material with a soft electric blue accent.
file_icon_3d.usage: Use inside the drag-and-drop zone or the success screen as a premium hero visual for the empty state (w-24 h-24).

abstract_pattern_unsplash.description: Abstract blue and white shapes with motion blur.
abstract_pattern_unsplash.usage: Alternative background texture or accent image if needed.

layout_structure.page: Min-h-screen bg-[#F9FAFB] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-8 relative
